thread:
Vivian L: Quick sync 0hrs until publish. We need the final changelog URL and a docs preview link by 4pm PT so social + press can be queued.
Arjun B: Changelog draft here: https://redwood.ai/changelog/launch-2026-05 (commit 5e2d9c). Key bullets: streaming latency improvements, smarter prefix caching, Dedicated capacity tuning.
Vivian L: Marketing lead wants a one-line headline + a 2-sentence blurb. Also must tag benchmark claims as 'preliminary internal benchmarks' per legal.
Maya K: Docs PR #710 ready: https://staging-docs.redwood.ai/launch-2026-05 (screenshots behind feature-flag in eu regions). I'll add a short FAQ about Dedicated pricing.
Deploy Bot: Canary scheduled Tue 02:00 PT -> canary-usw2; smoke tests 20m; notify: #eng-oncall. Job id: 880122.
Vivian L: Press embargo planned for Wed 08:30 PT. Marketing will post at 09:00 PT. If changelog/docs not live by 16:00 PT we hold and notify this thread.
Arjun B: Rollback owner: Arjun. Runbook: https://redwood.ai/runbooks/rollback-2026-05. Quick steps: revert to prior tag, rerun smoke, confirm p95 within SLA.
Maya K: Webinar Thursday 10am PT. Speakers: Maya (product), Arjun (tech). Leads from webinar should POST to webhook `https://hooks.redwood.ai/lead-launch-2026` with fields: name, email, company, interest_level, utm_campaign. Sample payload: ```{ "name":"Sam Demo","email":"sam@example.com","company":"ExampleCo","interest_level":"high","utm_campaign":"launch_may_2026" }```
Legal Bot: Reminder: change all GA phrasing to "available to reserved customers" and append bench hash. Mark latency claims as "preliminary internal benchmarks" and include bench link.
Vivian L: Noted. We'll use: "preliminary internal benchmarks (see bench.redwood.ai/run/6120)" in the public post.
Arjun B: One last infra note: canary pool has maintenance Tue 01:30 PT; we bumped canary to 03:00 PT to avoid conflict and updated the release doc.
Vivian L: Thanks 1 everyone. Final copy will be posted here by 4pm PT for a very quick legal sign-off. :white_check_mark: :rocket:
